Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I just went to the office mentioned in an orientation mail, and it took 5 min

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Guideance through my coordinator

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Very succesfull

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: It was no problem, but they begin their academic year in oktober usually, and they don't stress about the regristration, so don't worry too much about it, if you won't be able to register before the very last moment

Additional comments:

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The courses were very easy. It's because they were offered to a wide range of bachelor backgrounds, so with my bachelor in psychology, I found the material to be very similar to things I've already learned.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: More listening, less participation

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

Advanced Cognitive Psychology
Digital Society
Neuroethics
Additional Language Skills

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: They were all interesting, but I especially enjoyed Advanced Cognitive Psychology

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Restaurants, bars, and the cool cities in northern Italy

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Take long walks around the city, go to bars and travel a bit

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: A month or two to get the hang of it

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Speak italian

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Italians socialize in very closed and established groups, they can be challenging to become a part of

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: They do things in their own tempo, they don't stress about time, and they don't expect you to stress either. They might even find it annoying if you stress too much

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Bring some extra money, it's more fun that way
Find out how easy and cheap it is to take the train of flixbus to nice cities
Go see the mountains

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: The professors are very generous when grading Erasmus students, so don't stress too much

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Becoming a fluent italian speaker

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Becoming part of local italian friendgroups

questions.answer: Yes
